title: Cornerstop Dollar Store
content: Recently I seem to dream of going to the same dollar/discount store in my personal Mallworld. Sometimes I actually get there no problem and shop around, other times I get lost. The other night I somehow ended up lost in this same older part of town, with unusually tight roads with no sidewalks. These roads randomly cut through buildings. Then there is a stretch of perfectly straight road that's like maybe 6 lanes wide but you rarely see cars. Very wide sidewalks. Seems to be a nexus point between the Library, an elementary school, middle school and high school, and the college/university campus/dorms area. Then I came across a sideroad I haven't been to before. For some reason, it was some apartments boarded up with stacks of massive tree trunks out front. There was a river, but no water visible, just stuffed full of dirt, rock, sand, reeds, and many more massive tree trucks stripped of leaves. It was odd because at this point I was modestly lucid, but still somehow reluctant to explore the rivet. I found a sidewalk half covered in sand that led to the top of a hilly road, with a small grass park overlooking the homes apparently. The park was unusually small with oddly geometric edges to the grass and steep sides. The dream faded for some reason when I saw the same coastal cove and beach with shallow water I have seen in almost the same layout in previous dreams. For some odd reason, passing along with coastal mountain road lined with trees seems to be a needed route to access parts of the Mallworld. Yowzah, I get that was alot, but was some needed context. From previous dreams, it seems that the "Dollar store" is along that wider road someplace. The outside feels kinda retro, like 50s or 70s exterior, yet the inside is a mix of 80s and 90s vibe at an oddly specific time of sunset or sunrise. Loads of snacks and toys and such that in the dream i somwhow know what every last item is, but of course can barely remember when I wake up. It seems to be right next door to an automotive store, a taco shop, and a half outdoor and indoor kooky art store of some sort, stuffed full of bohemian style pottery, a mini built in food catering shop, and a room with nothing but birdhouses inside. All the walls and support beams covered in them, no wall space, from some unusually large birdhouses all the way down to some really amazingly tiny ones.
